GPTCache: File and image cache keys collide because BufferedReader.peek() only reads the buffered prefix

Aliases: CVE-2026-10812

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:L · CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:H/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:N/VI:L/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:P

Affected:

  • gptcache

A vulnerability was detected in zilliztech GPTCache up to 0.1.44. Affected by this issue is the function BufferedReader.peek of the file gptcache/processor/pre.py of the component Cache Key Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument input_data["image"] results in use of weak hash. The attack must be initiated from a local position. The attack is considered to have high complexity. The exploitation is known to be difficult. The exploit is now public and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

entry.title: [UPDATED] PYSEC-2026-1808: Pulp incorrectly assigns RBAC permissions in tasks that create objects
entry.content:
Pulp incorrectly assigns RBAC permissions in tasks that create objects

Aliases: CVE-2024-7143, GHSA-9m5j-4xx9-44j9

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:L · CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:H/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • pulpcore

A flaw was found in the Pulp package. When a role-based access control (RBAC) object in Pulp is set to assign permissions on its creation, it uses the `AutoAddObjPermsMixin` (typically the add_roles_for_object_creator method). This method finds the object creator by checking the current authenticated user. For objects that are created within a task, this current user is set by the first user with any permissions on the task object. This means the oldest user with model/domain-level task permissions will always be set as the current user of a task, even if they didn't dispatch the task. Therefore, all objects created in tasks will have their permissions assigned to this oldest user, and the creating user will receive nothing.
